issue.title: Refresh Bob Mac Capture idle-agenda docs images with the Calendar band once master CI is green
issue.description:
Epic bob-cli-f6 added the Calendar band and day rail to Bob Mac Capture's idle agenda (bob-mac-capture 28293b2, c4d8cf0) and render fixtures `agenda-events-{760,620}` (light/dark) plus `agenda-events-high-contrast-*` in `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureAgendaDesignTests.swift`. `docs/idle-agenda.md` documents the band but its images were not refreshed: `just docs-media` imports reviewed synthetic panel images only from the latest *successful* master CI, and master CI has been red.

Proposed by bob-cli-f6.8 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and routed by the bob-cli-f6 land agent. The f6 landing tale fixes the epic's own CI breakages (the CaptureAgendaDesignTests compile error and the Command-J router test); the remaining red baseline is bob-cli-f3.

Once master CI is green: run `just docs-media` in bob-mac-capture, confirm the imported idle-agenda images show the Calendar band (header with countdown and sync stamp, day rail, gap row, untracked dashed row, conflict row), add or update the `docs/idle-agenda.md` image references (and `docs/media.yml`), run `just docs-check`, and commit. Do not refresh before master CI is green.

task_type_fields.impact: The published Bob Mac Capture docs show the idle agenda without the Calendar band, day rail, and untracked rows that shipped.
task_type_fields.location: bob-mac-capture docs/idle-agenda.md, docs/media.yml, docs images imported by Scripts/docs-media.sh
task_type_fields.repro: bob-mac-capture docs/idle-agenda.md shows no Calendar band image although CaptureAgendaDesignTests renders agenda-events fixtures since c4d8cf0; gh run list --branch master shows every master CI run since 28293b2 failed, so just docs-media has no successful run to import from.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-f6.8 deferred the docs image import because docs-media only imports from a successful master CI run, so the published idle-agenda docs still lack the shipped Calendar band.
